decision: Continue only with bounded CPU corrective implementation in a later stage. Fixture-only repair is insufficient. Stop after this review as requested.

criteria.reason: Semantic amendment/source rule retained; frozen S0/native parents verify; all five current semantic tests passed.
limitations: Source/CPU scope only; new first-result/runtime gates incomplete; no repaired real-model output or measured quality.

criteria.reason: Failed validation, baseline lifecycle blockers and guard/coverage gaps; no production S1 authorization/admission/reservation.
No recovery attempt or terminal receipt; qualification and failure/partial evidence handling incomplete.
Frozen scientific records, original failures, aggregates/report and ledger unchanged; source/index unchanged during this review.
limitations: Mutable loop status differs from baseline between stages; preserved explicitly as bookkeeping difference, not claimed unchanged.
Does not repair historical P31-5 accounting failures.

findings.title: Contract fixture fails before the stage under test
findings.evidence: Exact prescribed CPU rerun: 134 tests, one error in kind=contract while constructing SegmentationResult.
findings.correction: Construct int32 labels, then convert prediction.labels to float32 inside mocked predict immediately before returning for kind=contract. Keep constructor/production contract unchanged. Assert exact error, output_contract phase, one call, raw evidence and no second input.

findings.title: Baseline wrongly freezes live ledger and mutable loop status
findings.evidence: Current loop status differs from its baseline; a synthetic admission append makes whole-ledger strict_record fail at registration. Tests use empty preserved_records.
findings.correction: Preserve baseline-001 and add immutable correction/binding policy: exact frozen scientific hashes, baseline-bound ledger byte prefix plus valid authorized appended chain, separately recorded loop bookkeeping transitions. Use consistently through terminal resolution.

findings.title: First-result numerical and retained metadata guards are incomplete
findings.evidence: Actual qualify_row accepts wrong-shape NaN detector_rgb and altered pixel detection box.
findings.correction: Validate frozen processed-image shape/finiteness/preprocessing, query-to-pixel-box mapping, retained id/index/order and native phrase consistency, including skipped/overwritten detections and zero detections.

findings.title: Loaded runtime and first-result envelope insufficiently verified
findings.evidence: Empty loaded-runtime manifest accepted; passed publication call silently returns existing failed first-result record; result validator omits request/amendment/runtime/check/timing envelope fields.
findings.correction: Verify interpreter and actual loaded source/native records against E1 and isolation roots; bind all first-result envelope fields; reject conflicting/failed existing record before processing another input.

findings.title: Partial outcome and blocked/terminal receipt lifecycle incomplete
findings.evidence: Completed rows live only in memory until success; receipt reads counts/runtime through finish.result; initial binding is outside try; blocked invocation can occupy fixed terminal receipt and later publication can mask primary error.
findings.correction: Persist immutable partial rows/runtime and exact failure phase; report produced/qualified counts; publish separate pre-dispatch block evidence; emit one verified consumed-attempt terminal receipt without hiding primary error. Test continuation without relaunch after reservation.

findings.title: Prelaunch and supervisor acceptance are not fully deadline bounded
findings.evidence: No remaining-time check after prelaunch binding; synchronous 510-row acceptance blocks monitoring and only flags overrun afterward.
findings.correction: Check remaining deadline immediately before launch; enforce bounded validation/resource checkpoints through result acceptance/evidence publication using fake-clock S1 tests; retain cleanup reserve and full membership checks.

findings.title: Tests do not qualify the real S1 controller/first-result lifecycle
findings.evidence: Synthetic admission events, empty preservation manifest, mocked qualify_row/qualify_runtime; no successful real qualification fixture. Suite substring matching accepts one-test receipt mentioning every suite.
findings.correction: Add integrated disposable lifecycle with mocked device/model only; exercise real numerical/runtime guards and baseline shape; add race/mutation/replay/partial/failure/deadline cases. Record actual per-suite/case collection and non-skipped passing receipts; issue missing implementation review.
